Landlord: Bracken Property Holdings plc, of 3 Wellington Place, Leeds LS1 4AP.
Tenant: Halcyon Retail Limited, of 18 Kirkstall Road, Leeds LS3 1LY.

Insurance premium: not stated in this document.
